applicabilityBasis.summary: dUSD is a transferable dollar-targeted stablecoin. Users mint and redeem it at dollar-valued parity against whitelisted stablecoins and yieldcoins rather than currency or bank deposits. The operative terms deny token-holder redemption rights against protocol participants and identify no legal issuer promising fixed monetary-value redemption. Stablecoin use and the documented in-kind redemption mechanism leave the GENIUS issuer-obligation element unresolved, supporting unclear applicability.

genius.notes: This assessment concerns dUSD, not the separately tracked sdUSD ERC-4626 yieldcoin. dUSD documentation describes atomic redemption for available reserve assets, with up to 0.5 percent fees; redemptionPolicyPresent records that published mechanism, not an enforceable right to redeem for fiat. The FAQ excludes United States users. Terms describe autonomous and semi-autonomous smart contracts, reserve and AMO administration through multisignatures and governance, and no guarantees of redemption or peg maintenance. No exact legal issuerEntity or domicile is attributed; Cayman governing law does not establish issuer domicile. No GENIUS issuance application or announced issuance route was identified. The clearer exclusion for sdUSD is not inherited by its stablecoin parent.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The public regulator resources, directories, exact-name Federal Register query and project disclosures checked on 2026-10-28 did not identify a GENIUS permitted issuer approval, state qualification, official pending application or registered foreign-issuer exception for dTRINITY dUSD. No named GENIUS issuance path was established in the reviewed project disclosures. This bounded finding does not rule out confidential, unindexed or differently named filings and does not treat general bank or virtual currency licenses as GENIUS permission.
